messages.subject: How can I change the button format for fileInput?
parts:
Hi, everyone - Please excuse this very simple question, but I am having trouble with the button format of "fileInput".

 

In short, I would like to re-format the button associated with "fileInput" to match the format of the "downloadButton". The standard format of the "downloadButton" looks much nicer and matches the rest of my application's theme. Here is the relevant part of my user interface:

 

downloadButton('downloadTemplate', 'Download Template')

fileInput("file1", label = NULL, accept = c(".xlsx")))

 

So, how can I change the format of the "fileInput" to match the standard format of the "downloadButton"?

 

I don't want to be overly picky about these kind of things, but as many of you know, selling applications like R Shiny to coworkers is challenging without the proper presentation. Thanks in advance for anyone who takes the time to help me out.

 

Cheers,

Joe
